dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent white annular rings located on the posterior-lateral flank; rings exhibit high-contrast, sharp outer boundaries with darker, lower-intensity centers. Includes a large sub-circular annulus positioned mid-body and a clustered group of smaller, interlocking C-shaped rings trailing posteriorly.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Dense concentration of irregular, high-intensity white patches and speckles scattered across the anterior dorsal region and mid-section, characterized by solid core pixel concentrations without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent annuli on the posterior flank form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the primary large annulus serving as the central vertex.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive chain-like interlocking sequence of white annuli on the lower lateral-posterior quadrant.
